in_sanskrit.name: Gitali
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Music, Song
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gitali एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gitali is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gitam' which means 'song' or 'melody'. In Hindu mythology, Gitali is the name of a river goddess and a consort of Lord Shiva. She is also known as 'Bhavani' and 'Ganga', and is worshipped for her musical and healing powers.
